description: The continuation root through main() on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL (one fresh schema, init-db first, no mask) over a fixture directory and a fixture runtime directory: status of an unknown policy and of none; identity, register and tick with no registered fleet; research-accept, research-supplement, capacity-grant and delivery-requalify of a file that is not JSON (the Fleet config is read first, so the refusal is the unregistered fleet's); ownership-reconcile of an unknown intent (the target sets ZEUS_COMPOSITION_PROFILE=development: declared difference E-c21); stdout, stderr and exit code per case, the fixture paths normalized
